name: Record
description: Long-playing records in colored vinyl, grooved rings round a bright paper label and a spindle hole, scattered so they overlap like a pile on the floor.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { transform: translate(@r(-16%, 16%), @r(-16%, 16%)) scale(@r(1, 1.25)); z-index: @ri(1, 9); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-mask: repeating-radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 0 5%, #0000009e 5% 7%), radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 5%, #000 5%); mask: repeating-radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 0 5%, #0000009e 5% 7%), radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 5%, #000 5%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 33%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 15%, #000 15%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 15%, #000 15%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
